record.name: Devin
record.one_liner: Devin is an autonomous AI software engineer built to help engineering teams write, run, and test code, manage sessions, playbooks, and repository documentation.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a Devin account at app.devin.ai, with self-serve free and paid plans available.
record.api_note: The Devin API provides broad capabilities covering organization sessions, knowledge management, playbooks, schedules, and enterprise controls.
